THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
THE STATEMENT
050
69 / Scarlet Column
Bold Contrast
A full-length studio portrait against a saturated red backdrop:
long straight black hair, red lips and a black strapless column
dress. One hand rests at the hip, with black patent stiletto pumps
grounding the pose.
70 / Navy Ruffle
Schoolroom Romance
A navy textured dress with a pale blue Peter Pan collar and cuffs,
a ruffled bodice tied with a long bow and a ruffled hem. Dark
knee-high socks, brown platform loafers and a leather crossbody
bag complete the look.
